bug_info.bug_desc: The PMPCFG write WARL logic incorrectly rejects the entire configuration write when the access type field has the reserved combination (R=0, W=1). According to the RISC-V spec, only the X, W, R fields form a collective WARL field; the write should be accepted and only the illegal field combination should be coerced to a legal value, not cause the entire pmpcfg entry to be discarded.
bug_info.fix_hint: For a writable PMPCFG entry with reserved R=0,W=1, retain the previous collective RWX field while accepting the independently legal address-mode and lock fields. Preserve existing entry-lock and read-only restrictions.

bug_info.bug_desc: When a writable PMPCFG entry requests unsupported NA4 address mode while its RWX permission field is legal, the all-or-nothing guard discards the whole entry. The unsupported address-mode value should retain the previous address-mode field; the independently legal permission and lock fields in that write must still take effect.
bug_info.fix_hint: For an unsupported NA4 address-mode write to a writable PMPCFG entry, retain the previous address-mode field and accept the independently legal RWX and lock fields. Preserve existing entry-lock and read-only restrictions.
